ALTER TABLE course_plan_request
    ADD COLUMN learning_path_id uuid;

ALTER TABLE planner_outbox
    DROP CONSTRAINT planner_outbox_schema_version_check,
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_planner_outbox_schema_version CHECK (schema_version IN (1, 2));

CREATE INDEX course_plan_request_learning_path_idx
    ON course_plan_request(student_id, learning_path_id, created_at DESC)
    WHERE learning_path_id IS NOT NULL;
